component.name: Usenet GoUp
component.summary: Pack, protect and upload files to Usenet with NZB output

description.p: Usenet GoUp packs files (RAR5, 7-Zip or native splitting) or uploads them unchanged, creates PAR2 recovery files, uploads over NNTP with yEnc and writes an NZB plus a BBCode posting template.
It runs locally and is operated through a web interface that only listens on this computer.
